messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MPON reports the meter operation to the GO. The GO examines the application of the MPON. The GO rejects the application of the MPON or the GO confirmes the application of the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The MPON and the MPOO perform the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes. The MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process or the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the entire process. The GO informs the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction by deadline if after a maximum time limit no message of the MPON is present at the GO. If the MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process, the GO confirms the failure of the assignment to the MPON. If the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the overall process, the GO assigns the MPON. The GO confirms the assignment to the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MPOO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the MPON.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="MPONRegistrationProcess" name="MPON Registration Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Final</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <!-- MPON Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MPON" name="MPON">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportMeterOp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EquipAcq</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoFailure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoSuccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_ConfirmAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_ConfirmFail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_Event</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Timer_Fail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Merge_Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- GO Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_GO" name="GO">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AppResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RejectApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMPOO_Reg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMSPO_Reg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_ProcResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ProcResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignMPON</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmFail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMPOO_Assign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMSPO_Assign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoSP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMPON_DeadlineFail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- MPOO Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MPOO" name="MPOO">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_RegConfirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EquipAcq_MPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_AssignResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- MSPO Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MSPO" name="MSPO">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_RegConfirm_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_AssignResult_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- SP Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SP" name="SP">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_Assign_SP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- Flows and Elements -->

    <!-- Start to Report -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_ReportMeterOp" />

    <!-- MPON Reports to GO -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportMeterOp" name="Report meter operation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ReportMeterOp" targetRef="Task_ExamineApp" />

    <!-- GO Examines -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineApp" name="Examine application" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ExamineApp" targetRef="Gateway_AppResult" />

    <!-- Gateway Application Result -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AppResult" name="Application Result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Reject Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_AppResult" targetRef="Task_RejectApp" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectApp" name="Reject application" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndReject" sourceRef="Task_RejectApp" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

    <!-- Confirm Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_AppResult" targetRef="Task_ConfirmApp" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmApp" name="Confirm application" />
    
    <!-- Inform MPOO and MSPO about Registration Confirmation -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMPOOReg" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmApp" targetRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Reg" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMPOO_Reg" name="Inform MPOO about registration confirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMSPOReg" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmApp" targetRef="Task_InfoMSPO_Reg" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMSPO_Reg" name="Inform MSPO about registration confirmation" />

    <!-- Equipment Acquisition (Parallel between MPON and MPOO) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEquipMPON" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Reg" targetRef="Task_EquipAcq" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EquipAcq" name="Perform equipment acquisition / changes" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEquipMPOO" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Reg" targetRef="Task_EquipAcq_MPOO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EquipAcq_MPOO" name="Perform equipment acquisition / changes" />

    <!-- Merge Equipment Tasks to Wait for Result -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaitResult" name="Wait for Process Result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromEquipMPON</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromEquipMPOO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToReceiveResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromEquipMPON" sourceRef="Task_EquipAcq" targetRef="Gateway_WaitResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromEquipMPOO" sourceRef="Task_EquipAcq_MPOO" targetRef="Gateway_WaitResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReceiveResult" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitResult" targetRef="Receive_ProcResult" />

    <!-- Receive Result from MPON with Timer Boundary Event -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Receive_ProcResult" name="Receive process result from MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToReceiveResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToProcGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Timer_Fail" name="Deadline exceeded" attachedToRef="Receive_ProcResult" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition />
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TimerFail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToProcGateway" sourceRef="Receive_ProcResult" targetRef="Gateway_ProcResult" />
    
    <!-- Gateway Process Result -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProcResult" name="Process Result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToProcGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Success</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Failure</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Success Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Success" name="Successful completion" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcResult" targetRef="Task_AssignMPON" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignMPON" name="Assign MPON" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToConfirmAssign" sourceRef="Task_AssignMPON" targetRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmAssign" name="Confirm assignment to MPON" />
    
    <!-- Failure Path (Explicit from MPON) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Failure" name="Failure of entire process" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcResult" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFail" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmFail" name="Confirm failure of assignment to MPON" />

    <!-- Deadline Failure Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerFail" sourceRef="Boundary_Timer_Fail" targetRef="Task_InfoMPON_DeadlineFail" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMPON_DeadlineFail" name="Inform MPON about failure by deadline" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToConfirmFail" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPON_DeadlineFail" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFail" />

    <!-- Post Assignment/Failure Actions -->
    <!-- From Confirm Assign -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CA_ToMPOO" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Assign" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMPOO_Assign" name="Inform MPOO about assignment/failure" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CA_ToMSPO" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="Task_InfoMSPO_Assign" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMSPO_Assign" name="Inform MSPO about assignment/failure" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CA_ToSP" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="Task_InfoSP" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoSP" name="Inform SP about assignment" />

    <!-- From Confirm Fail -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CF_ToMPOO" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFail" targetRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Assign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CF_ToMSPO" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFail" targetRef="Task_InfoMSPO_Assign" />
    <!-- Note: SP is only informed about assignment, not failure, based on text "The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the MPON." -->

    <!-- Final Merge to End -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalMerge" name="Final Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromMPOOAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromMSPOAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromSP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Final</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromMPOOAssign" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Assign" targetRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromMSPOAssign" sourceRef="Task_InfoMSPO_Assign" targetRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromSP" sourceRef="Task_InfoSP" targetRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Final" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

    <!-- Message Flows -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_Report" sourceRef="Task_ReportMeterOp" targetRef="Task_ExamineApp" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_RegConfirmMPOO" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Reg" targetRef="Receive_RegConfirm" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_RegConfirm" name="Receive registration confirmation" />
    
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_RegConfirmMSPO" sourceRef="Task_InfoMSPO_Reg" targetRef="Receive_RegConfirm_MSPO" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_RegConfirm_MSPO" name="Receive registration confirmation" />

    <!-- Implicit message flow for Equip Acq coordination if needed, but modeled as parallel tasks in lanes -->
    
    <!-- Message Flow for Process Result -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_ProcResult" sourceRef="Task_EquipAcq" targetRef="Receive_ProcResult" />
    <!-- Note: The text says MPON informs GO. Task_EquipAcq is in MPON lane. Receive_ProcResult is in GO lane. -->

    <!-- Message Flow for Confirm Assignment -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_ConfirmAssign" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="Receive_ConfirmAssign" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_ConfirmAssign" name="Receive confirmation of assignment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RC_ToEnd" sourceRef="Receive_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

    <!-- Message Flow for Confirm Failure -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_ConfirmFail" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFail" targetRef="Receive_ConfirmFail" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_ConfirmFail" name="Receive confirmation of failure" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RCF_ToEnd" sourceRef="Receive_ConfirmFail" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

    <!-- Message Flow for Deadline Info -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_DeadlineInfo" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPON_DeadlineFail" targetRef="Receive_ConfirmFail" /> 
    <!-- Correction: The task informs MPON. So it should go to a receive task in MPON lane or just be an action. 
         The text says "GO informs the MPON...". Then "If ... no message ... present at GO". 
         Let's model the notification to MPON explicitly. -->
         
    <!-- Refined Deadline Logic: 
         1. Timer fires on Receive_ProcResult (GO).
         2. GO performs Task_InfoMPON_DeadlineFail.
         3. This sends a message to MPON.
         4. MPON receives it.
         5. GO then proceeds to ConfirmFail.
    -->
    
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_DeadlineFail" name="Receive failure notification" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_DeadlineNotify" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPON_DeadlineFail" targetRef="Receive_DeadlineFail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RD_ToEnd" sourceRef="Receive_DeadlineFail" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

    <!-- Message Flows for Final Notifications -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_AssignMPOO" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPOO_Assign" targetRef="Receive_AssignResult" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_AssignResult" name="Receive assignment result" />
    
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_AssignMSPO" sourceRef="Task_InfoMSPO_Assign" targetRef="Receive_AssignResult_MSPO" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_AssignResult_MSPO" name="Receive assignment result" />
    
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg_AssignSP" sourceRef="Task_InfoSP" targetRef="Receive_Assign_SP" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Assign_SP" name="Receive assignment" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
